name: http-api
description: For any QA system that serves the bench's run API (README.md): hands it the brief, polls until done, and maps its findings and reported cost into bench findings. It never asks the system to promote checks or change stored baselines.
needs_approval: A system that is not on this machine may spend money; the adapter refuses a non-local API URL unless QA_BENCH_REMOTE_APPROVED=1.
